actuator_shift_mm.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
actuator_shift_mm.source: study B's actuator stack moved forward so the wire anchor ring clears the counter-face head's swept face (study B: back plate at z 25.93; the bore is 22 mm from z 20)

wire_length_mm.label: CALCULATION
wire_length_mm.source: study B's wire length (bnib optimiser), kept

ball_guide.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
ball_guide.source: Rev K: a planar ball thrust guide on both faces of the carrier flange (Si3N4 balls on 440C races on preloaded wave springs, hard stops 20 um behind), <= 2 um play; the races as wide as the balls' rolling (half the flange's stroke) and clear of the wires' envelope

lateral_stop.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
lateral_stop.source: the carrier's lateral stop moves to the carrier tube inside the cone: a Ti bush with a thin polyimide face on three spokes (stiff enough that the coils stay off the bore in a 1 m drop)

board.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
board.source: 4-layer board on top above the wires (Rev J.1: 1 x 14 x 22 mm at x 7.5)

hall_pkg.label: MANUFACTURER
hall_pkg.source: TMAG5170A1QDGKR, VSSOP-8 3.0 x 3.0 mm body, 4.9 mm over the leads, 1.1 mm high (OPT-44 / AMF-250); on a flex tab carried by the rear race ring; die 1.7 mm behind the position magnet's centre (PROPOSED DESIGN: keeps the field inside the A1 range)

head_walls.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
head_walls.source: follower carriage (Ti, slides in the 22 mm bore) and roll cage (PEEK-CF, turns in the carriage)

lra.label: ASSUMPTION
lra.source: 8 mm coin LRA on edge under the cell (AMF-45 class)

rear_cap_len_mm.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
rear_cap_len_mm.source: rear cap with two gold charging pads for a cradle (pogo pins)

rho_g_cc.label: MANUFACTURER
rho_g_cc.source: handbook densities (AMF-24 PEEK, AMF-21 Ti; others catalogue)
